concept.concept: Illustrated sourdough starter jar with cartoon eyes and the text 'I Feed My Starter Before My Family'
concept.audience: Home bakers obsessed with sourdough who follow bread-making communities online
concept.rationale: Sourdough culture remains a strong hobbyist niche with self-deprecating humor resonating well. No IP issues. Dedicated Facebook and Reddit communities share merch constantly. Humor angle reduces design competition versus plain bread illustrations.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I Feed My Starter Before My Family" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a glass mason jar filled with bubbly sourdough starter, centered composition. The jar has two large cartoon eyes (black circles with white highlights) positioned on the upper portion, giving it a friendly character. Inside the jar, show thick creamy starter with visible bubbles in solid tan and cream colors. The jar is glass-clear with bold black outlines and minimal detail. Simple wooden spoon resting in the jar. Solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Color palette: black outlines, cream, tan, light gray for jar highlight, warm white. Plain solid cream background, generous margin around design, all elements centered and away from edges.
design.text_on_design: I Feed My Starter Before My Family
design.style: Bold retro sans-serif, all caps, arched below the jar illustration in black, high contrast, screen-print ready

verdict.reason: The phrase 'I Feed My Starter Before My Family' is a generic humorous statement about sourdough baking culture with no known trademark associations. The illustrated sourdough jar with cartoon eyes is a common whimsical design trope. No celebrity, brand, character, team, or protected slogan references are present. The humor is based on a relatable everyday concept and poses minimal IP risk.

image_verdict.reason: Text reads exactly 'I FEED MY STARTER BEFORE MY FAMILY' — correctly spelled and complete. The design features a clean cartoon mason jar with a sourdough starter character (googly eyes, wooden spoon), clear artwork with no IP conflicts, no anatomy issues, and a plain background suitable for garment printing.
